high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "domestika." The post is a sponsored advertisement for a course titled "Design Products of the Future," created by Cecilia Tham. The post features a photograph of a futuristic-looking product, which appears to be a mobile terrarium or a plant enclosure with wheels. The structure has a hexagonal frame made of transparent and wooden elements, enclosing a potted plant inside. The price of the course is prominently displayed as ₹199, with a discounted price of ₹829 shown above it.
